name: UI：淘内资源池-模板预览详情验证
description: 点击模板卡片进入预览，验证大图/标签/曝光数/店铺信息

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[class*=template],[class*=card] img,[class*=item] img'); if(imgs.length > 0) { imgs[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=card],[class*=item]'); if(cards.length > 0) { cards[0].click(); return 'clicked card'; } return 'no clickable'; })()
(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); return { hasModal: !!modal, hasDrawer: !!drawer }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在模板资源数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 预览形式: Drawer/Modal/图片放大
